purpose: Single source of taste: agents consume the human-approved style reference ONLY through scripts/style-reference-adapter.js. No agent prompt, config, or code may restate envelope numbers or pattern statements (defect class STYLE_CONSTANT_DUPLICATION).

authority.authority_tier: HUMAN_STYLE_REFERENCE (rank 3): below live human decisions (rank 1) and episode-specific direction (rank 2); above agent recommendation, QC advisory, technical validation
authority.stale_rule: sha256 mismatch or non-ACTIVE status => NO authority, fail closed (STYLE_REFERENCE_BINDING_MISMATCH / STYLE_REFERENCE_STALE_BINDING); missing human-approval fields => STYLE_REFERENCE_NOT_HUMAN_APPROVED; succession is append-only — in-flight runs keep their frozen binding, new runs bind the successor explicitly
authority.advisory_firewall: Adapter output is evidence only: no disposition, no gate verdict, no aggregate score, no blocking field. No production code path may branch generation, plan mutation, or gate advancement on a style comparison result. Promotion of any style metric beyond advisory is a per-metric HUMAN decision after ~5-10 productions (decision record s22).

evaluator_parameters.no_event_review_s_provenance: VIDTOOLZ_STYLE_REFERENCE_V1 P-17 / QC-ADVISORY W-01: NO_MEANINGFUL_VISUAL_EVOLUTION_OVER_10S (review, not failure)
evaluator_parameters.dense_min_read_s_provenance: VIDTOOLZ-STYLE-ENVELOPE.json visual_hold_median_s envelope lower bound (4.0s); parameterized here rather than hard-coded so recalibration is a config change with provenance

consumers_planned_post_review: scripts/agent-task-visual-planning.js (task.creative_doctrine_ref population — requires AVP13 contract change + Mikko review)
qc-evidence-policy.js STYLE_REFERENCE_ADVISORY kind under APPLICABILITY class OPTIONAL_ADVISORY (never blocking)
consistency_rules: the adapter reads all envelope numbers from the reference artifact at load time; this contract carries only evaluator tuning parameters, each with provenance
role projections gate content by pattern confidence class: STRONG may shape defaults and warn on envelope exit; LIKELY suggests; OPTIONAL/SINGLE_VIDEO/UNCERTAIN never warn, never bind
absence of a non-required pattern is never a finding
findings against recorded human KEEP decisions resolve to INFORMATIONAL_ONLY; findings against declared episode deviations resolve to DEVIATION_ACKNOWLEDGED
